senses.gloss: m. pl.(also used as sing. f.) (κόσμος) jewelry.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:36">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> end <he>לאחד שגנב ק׳ וכ׳</he> like the case of one that stole jewelry from the royal palace, and gave it to his wife.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 732:3">Yalk. Num. 732</cite> (not <cite ref="S00279"><he>קוזמיין</he></cite>); Y’lamd. to Num. XI, 1 quot in Ar.—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 854:3">Yalk. Deut. 854</cite> <he>אני נתתי ק׳</he> … <he>אותה</he> I gave (my daughter) jewelry, and you lost it.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 12:1">Pesik. R. s. 12</cite>. Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Miḳḳets 9 <he>אם בא … ק׳ שלך וכ׳</he> if a man should come to borrow thy jewels, wouldst thou lend them to him?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 919:1">Yalk. Job 919</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>כל ק׳</he> … <he>וליתנם לה</he> Ar. (Ar. ed. Koh. <cite ref="S00282"><he>קוזמירין</he></cite>; ed. <cite ref="S00281"><he>קוזמיקון</he></cite>) all his jewels are there (in that barrel), and he wants to marry another wife and give them to her; <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 13:4">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XIII</cite> <cite ref="S00395"><he>קומיס</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00393"><he>קומיא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
